2162. Sum and Reverse of a Three-Digit Number

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a three-digit number and print the sum of its digits and the number formed by reversing its digits.
Description
Read a three-digit number. Find the sum of its three digits, and also find the number formed when its digits are written in reverse order. The reversed number is printed as a normal integer, so leading zeros are not printed. For example, 120 reversed is 021, which is printed as 21.
output_spec: Print the sum of the digits on the first line and the reversed number on the second line.
